chapters.reason: The paper implements DCoLT on LLaDA, a discrete-time masked diffusion language model, and discusses its unmasking policy, directly aligning with the description of masked diffusion models.
The paper also implements DCoLT on SEDD, a continuous-time discrete diffusion model operating on continuous embeddings with Gaussian noise, matching the embedding-based diffusion models category.

DCoLT uses outcome-based reinforcement learning to optimize the entire reasoning trajectory, which is a specialized training strategy for models with recurrent activation flows (the diffusion chain), addressing challenges of learning iterative computation.
